hotels.title: Luxurious Hawkesbury River Boutique Estate with Sydney's Largest Day Spa
hotels.description: Reconnect with nature at Crowne Plaza Hawkesbury Valley, an IHG Hotel, a boutique retreat hidden among eight hectares of landscaped gardens. A backdrop of jaw-dropping Blue Mountains views set the tone for your extravagant escape, just 45 minutes from Sydney's bright lights. When you're ready to feast on the region's finest produce, make a reservation at Harvest Restaurant for seasonal menus, an extensive wine list and glorious lakeside garden views. For a dose of relaxation, head to The Villa Thalgo Day Spa, Sydney's largest day spa.
